Jiguang Huo owns the retained verse: not the wind moving, not the flag moving — is it wind, is it flag? The twos and threes crane to look, till the watcher from the side rules it, and heart and bone spit out cold.

Senses.Explanation: The twos-and-threes of the Chan records: the scattered knots — the sages themselves split at the cut road-head, the fed assembly straying to the water-side, the way-man's walking with each not knowing the other, and the ferry's boats at rest. Tianyi Yihuai takes up the nine-jointed staff: cut through the road-head of the thousand sages, and Manjushri and Samantabhadra lose their seats in a fright, the ten-stage sages falling outright into twos and threes — then down from the seat, Wuzhun Shifan turns the two wheels: the food-wheel and the way-wheel both turning, the food's strength lasting seven days, then digested — the way forgotten with it — so off you go in twos and threes, by the water and under the trees, calling each other to roam, Guyin Yuncong is asked the way-man's walking and answers: in twos and threes, each not knowing the other; pressed for the bottom of it: tongue-cutting is your share, and Zhe'an Jingfan welcomes the worn travelers: by boat and by land, before and behind, through how many river-bends and mountain-turns, through endless perilous slopes — twos and threes gathering at the Yunmen gate, a rarely-met karmic meeting, gladly taking the rough fist and hot staff, hoping one half of one will thunder once in the layered clouds and heavy fog — not only the black dragon changing bone and the mist-leopard baring its pattern, but the eye of the way seen round and the true wind unfallen. Xingkong Xingzhen opens the third-month third: good things of many kinds — creek peaches spraying fire, bank willows dropping mist, purple swallows warbling deepest truth, partridges calling till the whole mechanism shows — spring light over the fields, spring color joining the sky: in twos and threes seeking the green, in threes and twos heel to heel and shoulder to shoulder, the fisherman casting his line, the herd-boy riding — every head on target, no thing leaning — then three monkeys winnowing coins on the pole-tip, Miyin Zhenchuan takes the meeting of the tenth-direction worlds — all the buddhas' life-line, all the sages' heart-source — how to meet them here? The Caishi ferry's wind and waves still: fishing boats in twos and threes — one shout, one staff-crack, down from the seat, and Jiguang Huo verses the wind-and-flag case: not the wind moving, not the flag moving — is it wind, is it flag? The twos and threes crane to look, till the one watching from the side rules it, and heart and bone spit out cold.
